newsitem.title: UK: UK's Moorfield wins support for development.
newsitem.headline: UK's Moorfield wins support for development.

text.p: British property developer Moorfield Estates Plc said on Tuesday it had won support from local authorities for its proposed 3.5 million square foot development at Teeside Airport in north east England.
The group said the first phase would comprise commercial development linked to the airport covering 1.8 million square feet.
The proposal will now be referred to the secretary of state for the environment as it involves a departure from local structure plans.
The project is expected to create thousands of local jobs and act as a catalyst for further development in the region. ---London Newsroom +44 171 542 4366
